# Support

## Where to Ask for Help

- bugs and regressions: GitHub Issues
- feature requests: GitHub Issues
- security vulnerabilities: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
- contribution process questions: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Before Opening an Issue

- read [README.md](../README.md)
- check the docs index at [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md)
- verify whether the issue is really a bug, feature request, or security report

## What Not to Post Publicly

Do not post public issues containing:

- secrets
- API keys or tokens
- raw logs with sensitive content
- customer files
- customer PII
- exploit details for an unpatched vulnerability

Use [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for security disclosures.

## Support Scope

This repository is maintained on a best-effort open-source basis. Maintainers
may prioritize:

- security issues
- correctness regressions
- data-protection issues
- API contract regressions

General implementation help may be answered as maintainers have time.
